description: Build unsigned transactions to buy a stock token on Robinhood Chain with ETH (`eth`, or `usd` worth of ETH) or sell `pct` percent of the wallet’s holding for ETH. `token` is a ticker (TSLA) or the token address. A buy needs the ETH, plus gas, already in `wallet`; if it is short, fund it with fund_agent first. The calls expire at valid_until: sign and send before then, or build the trade again. Returns calls for the wallet owner to sign and send in order on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). No keyfo tool signs. The answer also has sign_url: a keyfo page where the user checks the transaction and signs it in their own wallet. It stays open for 15 minutes and gets a new quote itself when the price is out of date. Show that link to the user, and never ask them to paste the transaction data anywhere.
